operations.description: Lists all hypernyms related to a family. A hypernym is a parent concent. E.g. "vehicle" is a hypernym of "truck".
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list hypernyms [PATH] hypernyms [PARAMS] apim family key level max ocp subscription [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists all hyponyms related to a family. A hyponym is a child concent. E.g. "truck" is a hypernym of "vehicle".
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list hyponyms [PATH] hyponyms [PARAMS] apim family key level max ocp subscription [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] list inflected forms [PATH] inflections [PARAMS] apim family key language lexeme ocp subscription [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Fetches and outputs metadata for a family from the Tisane language models.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] family details [PATH] lm family [PARAMS] apim id key ocp subscription [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Fetches and outputs all senses related to a word.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list word senses [PATH] senses [PARAMS] apim key language ocp subscription word [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Lists feature values for a particular category of features. This allows obtaining all the values such as entity types, subtypes, abuse types and tags, and more.

Returns the values as a JSON array of strings.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list feature values [PATH] values [PARAMS] apim description key language ocp subscription type [SCHEMA]
